source.title: Source context for nine coastal and reversing-flow reference extents

documents.title: Schott and McCreary2001, selected retained original text

method: WGS84 geodesic leg sums through explicit geographic reference extents. Source text/maps identify named-flow geography; OSW chooses the handoffs and connecting controls.

sensitivity.interpretation: Route-specific endpoint/drawing sensitivity. Coastal entries can declare smaller or one-sided offshore offsets. These are not physical confidence limits or annual variation; all cases retained.

dateline_policy: Shortest geodesics; continuous display unwrapping and periodic coarse land copies.

currents.source_locator: Chapter16 printed287-288 / PDF297-298, Figure16.18: usual penetration about27N, retracted path after shedding about25N; version December2001.
currents.scope: Yucatan Strait entrance to western Florida Strait handoff using a declared extended Loop phase. Detached rings, Caribbean upstream and Florida Current downstream are excluded.
currents.source_time_convention: Representative extended-loop convention; source Figure16.18 combines 1980-1984 mean and shedding states. No annual extrema or fixed seasonal phase inferred.
currents.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.

currents.source_locator: Chapter8 printed127-129 / PDF137-139, Figure8.23; version March2005. Australia to northern New Zealand near34S; strongly meandering and sometimes no identifiable continuous jet.
currents.scope: Declared Australia-New Zealand connection from EAC separation offshore New South Wales to offshore northern North Island handoff. Excludes upstream EAC and downstream East Auckland flow.
currents.source_time_convention: Historical geographic connection, not a dated observed axis. Source Figure8.23 includes September-October1979 observations; this route is not their digitization.
currents.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
currents.identity_interpretation: Tasman Front is a segment and statistical connection, not an independently additive current system.

currents.source_locator: Schott and McCreary2001 section5.1.1, printed57-59, Figures41-44: late September onset; November southward flow along east coasts of India and Sri Lanka, contrasting spring and summer confluence.
currents.scope: Declared November southward coastal envelope from offshore northern Bay of Bengal to southeast Sri Lanka monsoon-current handoff. No basin-interior gyre, offshore freshwater plume or downstream monsoon leg included.
currents.source_time_convention: November southward-phase geography in a review of different years; not all months, annual extremes or one observed continuous trajectory.
currents.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.

currents.source_locator: Schott and McCreary2001 section5.1.2, printed59-61: equatorward March-October surface phase; northward winter phase and southern Laccadive handoff.
currents.scope: Declared west-India surface coastal envelope from offshore Gujarat to offshore southwest-tip handoff near8N. Excludes coastal undercurrent, Laccadive gyre detours and Sri Lanka monsoon flow.
currents.source_time_convention: Common geographic envelope for reversing summer/winter phases; direction reverses and exact occupied extent is not measured.
currents.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.

currents.source_locator: Chapter11 printed181/196 / PDF191/206: winter eastward SECC continuation into South Java and Indonesian seas, strongest westward surface phase in August; December2001 version. Existing Iskandar2006/Sprintall2010 regional records distinguish Java-Bali reach and Sumatra/Savu-Ombai extensions.
currents.scope: Declared surface South Java/Sumatra coastal-system convention from offshore southwest Sumatra to Lombok handoff. Excludes upstream basin SECC, downstream Savu/Ombai branches and South Java Undercurrent.
currents.source_time_convention: Reversing surface-system geography; nominal line is eastward winter orientation, not a year-round axis.
currents.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
currents.identity_interpretation: Uses the broader South Java coastal-system interpretation including southwest Sumatra; narrower Java-only study reaches remain separately visible.

currents.source_locator: Schott and McCreary2001 section5.1.5, printed63-65: SMC from western Arabian Sea past south Sri Lanka turns north into Bay of Bengal; NMC reverses, June-September versus November-February.
currents.scope: Declared southwest-monsoon principal corridor from offshore western Arabian Sea source handoff to Bay of Bengal turning/handoff east of Sri Lanka. Excludes Somali boundary legs, equatorial Wyrtki jets, coastal WICC/EICC lengths and uncertain farther-east branch.
currents.source_time_convention: Southwest-monsoon June-September convention. Reverse NMC follows different detours; this is not its exact path or an annual maximum.
currents.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
currents.identity_interpretation: A principal SMC phase is the display convention for the named reversing monsoon-current system; opposite-phase geometry is not summed.

currents.source_locator: Chapter14 printed249-250 / PDF259-260, version September2002: poleward summer surface current south of Cap Blanc21N, winter subsurface continuation toward Cape Bojador27N.
currents.scope: Declared summer surface branch from offshore Senegal/Dakar source neighborhood to Cap Blanc handoff. Excludes winter poleward undercurrent north of21N, Canary equatorward jet and Guinea Dome loops.
currents.source_time_convention: Summer surface convention; not a year-round surface route or measured seasonal range.
currents.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
currents.identity_interpretation: Length applies to the summer surface branch. Extending to27N would change the vertical/seasonal object and is not included.

currents.source_locator: Sutherland and Pickart2008 sections3/3.5 and8-9: southeast shelf and Cape Farewell, weak assumed northern identification near68N, merging/approach to shelfbreak current near63N.
currents.scope: Conditional full southeast-Greenland coastal reference envelope from weak northern68N identification to Cape Farewell handoff. Excludes EGC shelfbreak route, offshore diversions and West Greenland continuation.
currents.source_time_convention: Geographic convention informed by the study sections; no continuous year-round isolated coastal axis inferred.
currents.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
currents.identity_interpretation: Northern extension and continuity as a separate coastal jet are uncertain; this provisional route explicitly adopts the weak68N identification.

currents.source_locator: Introduction and Figure1: Northern Current forms from west/east Corsica feeders, follows Ligurian-Provencal slope toward Gulf of Lion and Catalan basin.
currents.scope: Declared Ligurian regional segment of the Northern Current: north-Corsica feeder convergence neighborhood, offshore Ligurian arc, then eastern Provencal handoff. Excludes separate Corsica feeder lengths and downstream Gulf of Lion/Catalan continuation.
currents.source_time_convention: Geographic segment convention, not the December2011 experiment track or a measured annual path.
currents.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
currents.identity_interpretation: Catalog identity is a regional segment. This estimates the complete declared Ligurian segment, not the entire Northern Current.
